findings.title: Successful cleanup batches are logged at Error level
findings.body: In CleanAnnotations, CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags the new code calls r.log.Error(...) for every batch, including fully successful ones (e.g. `r.log.Error("Annotations to clean by time", "count", len(ids), "ids", ids, ...)` and the matching "cleaned annotations" / "Tags to clean" / "cleaned tags" calls at lines 534, 537, 554, 557, 576, 579). This is debug/diagnostic output, and now every annotation cleanup job run on every Grafana instance will emit Error-level log lines with the full list of deleted annotation IDs, polluting logs, potentially triggering alerting on error logs, and leaking annotation IDs. These should be Debug level (and drop the always-nil "err" field and the huge "ids" slice).

findings.title: Cleanup ticker changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute without mention in PR description
findings.body: The cleanup loop ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, but the PR description only discusses the annotation deadlock fix. This makes all cleanup jobs (snapshots, dashboard versions, images, annotations, invites, short URLs, query history) run 10x more often, which increases recurring database load for all users and is a behavior change that should be documented in the PR description / changelog. Note also that the per-run timeout in clean() remains 9 minutes, so the intended cadence is unclear; if a cleanup cycle takes several minutes, jobs effectively run back-to-back.
